sql: SELECT to_regclass('public.student_invitations')::text AS student_invitations_table, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size('public.users')) AS users_total_size, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE contype='f' AND confrelid='public.users'::regclass AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%REFERENCES users(email)%') AS email_reference_count
